decisions.reason: Replacing ordinary content-control fields with simple text may affect the grey editable-field cue, but simple text could still use grey styling; the source does not resolve the required visual cue.
For ordinary editable text, the selected simple-text mechanism replaces content-control activation and manual update or deletion replaces automatic placeholder clearing on field click.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Just use simple text that can be updated or deleted easily.

value_updates.replacement_text_behavior: use simple text that users can update or delete easily

decisions.reason: Using simple editable text does not change the requirement to preserve the Title field's intended formatting during editing.
The field implementation choice does not change the supported Word environment or the general reliability and multi-user stability expectations.
The simple-text decision concerns ordinary editable document text, not bullet sizing, alignment, scaling, or color.
The field mechanism decision does not alter the requirement to include the theme colors.
Enter-key bullet creation is a specialized bullet-area behavior and is not changed by the decision to use simple text for ordinary document text.
The source does not change legacy-content paste behavior, its test files, or the unresolved formatted-paste workflow.
The simple-text mechanism has no necessary effect on pasted table structure or column containment.
The source decision does not change manual line-break behavior after legacy-content pasting.
Choosing simple text for ordinary editable content does not change the required style-system source or catalog coverage.
The field implementation choice does not alter the NXQ style prefix, its application condition, or the Danish style-name language.
